mapper.select: SELECT i.item_no, i.seller_email, i.title, i.price, i.trade_type, i.category, i.age_range, i.`condition`, i.allow_offer, i.status, i.location_name, i.view_count, i.recall_flag, i.reg_time, img.file_name, img.ord AS img_ord FROM tbl_market_item i LEFT JOIN tbl_market_item_image img ON i.item_no = img.item_no AND img.ord = 0 WHERE i.del_flag = false ORDER BY i.item_no DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{skip}

SELECT i.item_no, i.seller_email, i.title, i.price, i.trade_type, i.category, i.age_range, i.`condition`, i.allow_offer, i.status, i.location_name, i.view_count, i.recall_flag, i.reg_time, img.file_name, img.ord AS img_ord FROM tbl_market_item i LEFT JOIN tbl_market_item_image img ON i.item_no = img.item_no AND img.ord = 0 WHERE i.del_flag = false AND i.seller_email = #{sellerEmail} ORDER BY i.item_no DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_market_item WHERE del_flag = false

SELECT item_no, seller_email, title, price, description, trade_type, category, age_range, `condition`, allow_offer, status, location_name, latitude, longitude, view_count, recall_checked, recall_flag, bump_at, del_flag, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_market_item WHERE item_no = #{itemNo}
SELECT file_name, ord FROM tbl_market_item_image WHERE item_no = #{itemNo} ORDER BY ord

SELECT i.item_no, i.seller_email, i.title, i.price, i.trade_type, i.category, i.status, i.location_name, i.latitude, i.longitude, img.file_name, img.ord AS img_ord FROM tbl_market_item i LEFT JOIN tbl_market_item_image img ON i.item_no = img.item_no AND img.ord = 0 WHERE i.del_flag = false AND i.status = '거래가능' AND i.latitude IS NOT NULL AND i.longitude IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_market_item (seller_email, title, price, description, trade_type, category, age_range, `condition`, allow_offer, status, location_name, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{sellerEmail}, #{title}, #{price}, #{description}, #{tradeType}, #{category}, #{ageRange}, #{condition}, #{allowOffer}, #{status}, #{locationName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
INSERT INTO tbl_market_item_image (item_no, file_name, ord) VALUES (#{itemNo}, #{image.fileName}, #{image.ord})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_market_item SET title = #{title}, price = #{price}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, age_range = #{ageRange}, `condition` = #{condition}, allow_offer = #{allowOffer}, status = #{status}, location_name = #{locationName}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude} WHERE item_no = #{itemNo}
